rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose verb for saying that something includes particular parts or elements.

example.english: This set menu can comprise a drink and a dessert.
example.traditional: 呢份套餐包括飲品同甜品。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 tou3 caan1 baau1 kut3 jam2 ban2 tung4 tim4 ban2

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing what something is made up of as a whole, especially when listing its constituent parts.

example.english: Devices like this can comprise a sensor, a battery, and a display.
example.traditional: 呢類裝置可以由感應器、電池同顯示屏組成。
example.jyutping: nei1 leoi6 zong1 zi3 ho2 ji5 jau4 gam2 jing3 hei3 din6 ci4 tung4 hin2 si6 ping4 zou2 sing4

rows.note: Use this casual choice when simply listing what a group, set, or invention has in it.

example.english: Our tour group can comprise elderly people, children, and a few foreigners.
example.traditional: 我哋個旅行團有老人家、細路仔，仲有幾個外國人。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 go3 leoi5 hang4 tyun4 jau5 lou5 jan4 gaa1 sai3 lou6 zai2 zung6 jau5 gei2 go3 ngoi6 gwok3 jan4
